scientific_integrity: Known upper bound and maximizing vector credited to Ruiz-Herrera and Torres (2020); claim is finite-symmetric graph-cut characterization and explicit construction. Mathematical tests complement, but do not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact achievability of a previously known universal bound under arbitrary finite nonnegative symmetric corridor weights. Does not optimize below the bound; no conductance budgets, compulsory positive edges or asymmetric migration. Literature comparison cannot prove absolute novelty.
title: Finite symmetric dispersal attains the logistic biomass bound exactly under directed-cut feasibility
